A1.justification: Both PDFs clearly describe the same RS-4M/SelectiveMAE work, and their supplied pages are readable. However, v2 ends after the references while repeatedly directing readers to an appendix that is not included. This limits verification of detailed method equivalence, although the retained experiments and document-level omissions can be compared reliably.

before.justification: V1 reports original pre-training and downstream classification, detection, and segmentation experiments, together with component ablations and qualitative predictions in its appendix.

after.justification: V2 retains original downstream experiments and reports additional results for a one-million-image dataset subset and training-time comparisons.

M1.justification: The retained description preserves HOG-based reconstruction, cross-attention decoding, 85% masking, 25% reconstruction, and progressive semantic token selection. However, v2 defers the detailed selection procedure to its absent appendix, preventing reliable verification of the complete algorithm against v1's equations and pseudocode. The new pipeline framing alone does not establish a procedural change.

E1.justification: RS-4M becomes OpticalRS-4M, with the same four-million-image optical dataset and depicted source composition. AID, RESISC-45, DIOR, DIOR-R, LoveDA, and SpaceNetv1 remain the evaluation datasets. The new category hierarchy characterizes existing coverage, while the one-million-image subset changes sample size rather than task or domain coverage.

E2.justification: V1 Table 3 evaluates CrossMAE, SatMAE, and ScaleMAE alongside MAE for efficiency; v2's efficiency comparisons include only MAE. V1 Table 2's ATS partial-reconstruction comparator is also absent. The comparator membership of the main downstream table remains unchanged, including SatMAE and ScaleMAE there.

E3.justification: Efficiency evaluation changes from images per minute to total training hours, with v2 Table 4 explicitly evaluating ViT-B/L timing on MillionAID. V2 also adds a one-million-image, 800-epoch matched-throughput dataset control and an 800-epoch timing study across one-million and four-million subsets. Missing hyperparameter disclosures do not establish changes to the retained experiments' actual settings.

E4.justification: The supplied v2 omits v1's partial-reconstruction strategy comparison, training-instability plots, reconstruction-ratio, masking-ratio, decoder-depth and PSTS-order ablations, and downstream prediction case studies. It adds category-composition analysis and training-cost scalability analysis. The dataset-size and extended-training analyses largely relocate existing appendix evidence.

E5.justification: Neither supplied PDF reports repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests for its experimental scores. The new category summary and timing rows do not introduce uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: V1 Table 4 and v2 Table 6 have identical downstream scores, and the extended-training results also match. V2 adds the one-million-image control, including 75.90 DIOR mAP50 and 53.10 LoveDA mIoU, and total-time results such as 177 versus 86 hours. These replace throughput-based efficiency evidence, while component-ablation and qualitative results are omitted. V2 Table 5 incorrectly reports an 81-hour saving for 177 versus 86 hours; the difference is 91.

T1.justification: The formal specification is substantially reduced in the supplied v2. V1's PSTS initialization, stage-dependent distance rules, and token-set updates in Equations 2–6 are absent; v2 retains Equation 1 and refers readers to the unavailable appendix. This is a loss of mathematical definitions, without establishing a change to the underlying algorithm.

C1.justification: V2 elevates the combined data-collection and efficient-pre-training pipeline to an explicit headline contribution. It drops the introduction's specific 5.6% mAP and 1.4% mF1 improvement claims and replaces the 2.2–2.7× headline speedup with over 2×. The central dataset, SelectiveMAE, and 40%-patch claims remain.

C2.justification: V1 Section 7.2 acknowledges the 0.1-point AID accuracy deficit and explains it through lost global context; v2 retains those scores but describes SelectiveMAE as outperforming MAE without that qualification. V2 also omits component-design tradeoffs and limitations concerning detection/segmentation data imbalance and computational accessibility. Its dataset-size versus training-duration interpretation is refined, but largely retains v1's explanation.

D1.justification: V2 omits v1 Table 9 and associated optimizer, learning-rate, warmup, augmentation, split, and implementation-library details, along with dataset licensing and maintenance disclosures. It adds total training hours on eight A100 GPUs and expands collection criteria. The basic preprocessing steps and repository destination remain equivalent; omitted disclosures do not demonstrate withdrawn resources or changed settings.

R1.justification: V2 adds SSL4EO-L, SkyScript, and RS5M references and expands positioning against multispectral, SAR, and vision-language datasets. AdaMAE and Datasheets for Datasets references disappear. SSL4EO-S12's publication update concerns an already cited work, and the broader related-work framework remains recognizable.

P1.justification: V2 substantially rewrites the abstract, contribution narrative, dataset discussion, and conclusion around a unified pipeline. Separate Dataset and Method sections become Methodology subsections, related-work topics are reordered, and experiments adopt an ablation-first structure incorporating selected appendix material. PSTS exposition is substantially shortened.

P2.justification: V2 adds a full-page category hierarchy with labeled examples and revises Figure 1's dataset-comparison bars and legend. Selected appendix tables move into the main text, efficiency tables change structure, and the loss plots, component-ablation displays, configuration table, and prediction panels disappear. The method overview is retained and renumbered; extensive red revision text also changes presentation.

improvement.justification: For the supplied PDFs, useful dataset characterization, an equal-size control, and total-time measurements are outweighed by loss of the detailed PSTS specification, component validation, reproducibility settings, and substantive qualifications. V2 repeatedly relies on an appendix that is absent, substantially weakening scrutiny and reproducibility of its central method. Its new timing analysis also introduces the incorrect 81-hour saving in Table 5.
